2311-travels-through-france-and-italy.title: Travels Through France And Italy
2311-travels-through-france-and-italy.creator: Tobias Smollett
2311-travels-through-france-and-italy.description: A book by Tobias Smollett. the founder to some extent of a school of professional writers, of which strange and novel class, after the "Great Cham of Literature," as he called Dr. Johnson, he affords one of the first satisfactory specimens upon a fairly large scale. He is, indeed, a more satisfactory, because a more independent, example of the new species than the Great Cham himself.

59011-the-last-crusade.title: The Last Crusade
59011-the-last-crusade.creator: Unknown
59011-the-last-crusade.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. "I'll bet they ain't got anything like we got." I was feeling pretty fine right then thinking how much better off we was than the poor joes in the infantry. We don't just fight in our suits, we live in 'em. They ain't only a mechanized suit of armor, they're our barracks, messroom and latrine and all radiation and rain proof.

arxiv-2011-08337.title: Optimal Transport-based Coverage Control for Swarm Robot Systems: Generalization of the Voronoi Tessellation-based Method
arxiv-2011-08337.creator: Daisuke Inoue, Yuji Ito, Hiroaki Yoshida
arxiv-2011-08337.description: Abstract Swarm robot systems, which consist of many cooperating mobile robots, have attracted attention for their environmental adaptability and fault tolerance advantages. One of the most important tasks for such systems is coverage control, in which robots autonomously deploy to approximate a given spatial distribution.

arxiv-2107-11094.title: Improving Early Sepsis Prediction with Multi Modal Learning
arxiv-2107-11094.creator: Fred Qin, Vivek Madan, Ujjwal Ratan, Zohar Karnin, Vishaal Kapoor, Parminder Bhatia, Taha Kass-Hout
arxiv-2107-11094.description: Abstract Sepsis is a life-threatening disease with high morbidity, mortality and healthcare costs. The early prediction and administration of antibiotics and intravenous fluids is considered crucial for the treatment of sepsis and can save potentially millions of lives and billions in health care costs.

arxiv-2109-14370.title: Objective-oriented method for uniformation of various directivity representations
arxiv-2109-14370.creator: Adam Szwajcowski
arxiv-2109-14370.description: Abstract Over recent years, numerous attempts were taken to provide efficient methods of directivity representation, either regarding sound sources or head-related transfer functions. Because of the wide variety of programming tools and scripts used by different researchers, the resulting representations are inconvevnient to reproduce and compare with each other, hampering the development of the subject.

arxiv-2303-12754.title: Communication Body-UAV Near-Ground LoRa Links through a Mediterranean Forest
arxiv-2303-12754.creator: Giulio Maria Bianco, Gaetano Marrocco
arxiv-2303-12754.description: Abstract LoRa low-power wide-area network protocol has recently gained attention for deploying ad-hoc search and rescue (SaR) systems. They could be empowered by exploiting body-UAV links that enable communications between a body-worn radio and a UAV-mounted one. However, to employ UAVs effectively, knowledge of the signal’s propagation in the environment is required. Otherwise, communications and localization could be hindered.

arxiv-2305-02656.title: The Quantum Internet: an Efficient Stabilizer states Distribution Scheme
arxiv-2305-02656.creator: Seid Koudia 3
arxiv-2305-02656.description: Abstract Quantum networks constitute a major part of quantum technologies. They will boost distributed quantum computing drastically by providing a scalable modular architecture of quantum chips, or by establishing an infrastructure for measurement based quantum computing. Moreover, they will provide the backbone of the future quantum internet, allowing for high margins of security.

arxiv-2311-16162.title: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence Technology for Mapping Research to Sustainable Development Goals: A Case Study
arxiv-2311-16162.creator: Hui Yin, Amir Aryani, Gavin Lambert, Marcus White, Luis Salvador-Carulla, Shazia Sadiq, Elvira Sojli, Jennifer Boddy, Greg Murray, Wing Wah Tham
arxiv-2311-16162.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Hui Yin, Amir Aryani, Gavin Lambert, Marcus White, Luis Salvador-Carulla, Shazia Sadiq, Elvira Sojli, Jennifer Boddy, Greg Murray, Wing Wah Tham. The number of publications related to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) continues to grow. These publications cover a diverse spectrum of research, from humanities and social sciences to engineering and health. Given the imperative of funding bodies to monitor outcomes and impacts, linking publications to relevant SDGs is critical but remains time-consuming and difficult given the breadth and complexity of the SDGs.

arxiv-2401-03771.title: NeRFmentation: Improving Monocular Depth Estimation with NeRF-based Data Augmentation
arxiv-2401-03771.creator: Casimir Feldmann *, Niall Siegenheim *, Nikolas Hars, Lovro Rabuzin, Mert Ertugrul, Luca Wolfart, Marc Pollefeys, Zuria Bauer, Martin R. Oswald
arxiv-2401-03771.description: Abstract The capabilities of monocular depth estimation (MDE) models are limited by the availability of sufficient and diverse datasets. In the case of MDE models for autonomous driving, this issue is exacerbated by the linearity of the captured data trajectories.

arxiv-2406-04131.title: KIC 4150611: A quadruply eclipsing heptuple star system with a g-mode period-spacing pattern
arxiv-2406-04131.creator: Alex Kemp, Andrew Tkachenko, Guillermo Torres, Krešimir Pavlovski, Luc IJspeert, Nadya Serebriakova, Kyle Conroy, Timothy Van Reeth, David Latham, Andrej Prša, Conny Aerts

arxiv-2502-12564.title: Sample Efficient Omniprediction and Downstream Swap Regret for Non-Linear Losses
arxiv-2502-12564.creator: Jiuyao Lu, Aaron Roth, Mirah Shi
arxiv-2502-12564.description: Abstract We define “decision swap regret” which generalizes both prediction for downstream swap regret and omniprediction, and give algorithms for obtaining it for arbitrary multi-dimensional Lipschitz loss functions in online adversarial settings. We also give sample complexity bounds in the batch setting via an online-to-batch reduction.

arxiv-2503-04575.title: On Approximate Representation of Fractional Brownian Motion
arxiv-2503-04575.creator: Konstantin A. Rybakov
arxiv-2503-04575.description: Abstract Abstract. This paper considers the orthogonal expansion of the fractional Brownian motion relative to the Legendre polynomials. It has not only theoretical but also practical interest, since it can be applied to approximate and simulate the fractional Brownian motion in continuous time.

arxiv-2510-17210.title: Wisdom is Knowing What not to Say: Hallucination-Free LLMs Unlearning via Attention Shifting
arxiv-2510-17210.creator: Chenchen Tan , Youyang Qu , Xinghao Li , Hui Zhang , Shujie Cui , Cunjian Chen , Longxiang Gao Faculty of Information Technology, Monash University, Australia Key Laboratory of Computing Power Network and Information Security, Ministry of Education, Shandong Computer Science Center, Qilu University
arxiv-2510-17210.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chenchen Tan , Youyang Qu , Xinghao Li , Hui Zhang , Shujie Cui , Cunjian Chen , Longxiang Gao Faculty of Information Technology, Monash University, Australia Key Laboratory of Computing Power Network and Information Security, Ministry of Education, Shandong Computer Science Center, Qilu University . The increase in computing power and the necessity of AI-assisted decision-making boost the growing application of Large Language Models (LLMs). Along with this, the potential retention of sensitive data of LLMs has spurred increasing research into machine unlearning.

pmc-10533194.title: Phase Field Simulation of the Effect of Second Phase Particles with Different Orientations on the Microstructure of Magnesium Alloys
pmc-10533194.creator: Yan Wu, Jinlin Xiong, Shuo Wang, Junsheng Yang, Mingtao Wang
pmc-10533194.description: In this study, the phase field method has been used to study the effect of second phase particles with different shapes and different orientations on the grain growth of AZ31 magnesium alloy, after annealing at 350 °C for 100 min.

pmc-10735785.title: SENSORIMOTOR IMPAIRMENTS AND DEMENTIA: A CROSS-SECTIONAL ANALYSIS OF NATIONAL HEALTH AND AGING TRENDS STUDY
pmc-10735785.creator: Anis Davoudi, Yuri Agrawal, Alden Gross, Amal Wanigatunga, Nicholas Reed, Joshua Ehrlich, Jennifer Schrack
pmc-10735785.description: Sensory impairments in vision and hearing are linked to dementia in older adults. However, this association has not been investigated in conjunction with motor function performance. We examined cross-sectional sensory and motor function and dementia status data from 1,765 participants in the National Health and Aging Trends Study (NHATS R11, 2021) (32.

pmc-10750551.title: Comparing the Utility of Custom Foot Orthoses vs Prescription-grade Prefabricated Foot Orthoses
pmc-10750551.creator: Samuel D. Stark, Michael A. Hewitt, Sara E. Buckley, Teresa Alpert, Brady T. Williams, Kenneth Hunt
pmc-10750551.description: Category:Hindfoot; AnkleIntroduction/Purpose:Both prefabricated and custom-made foot orthoses have long been effective treatment foot and ankle conditions and deformities. Foot orthoses function by replacing the insole of a shoe to redistribute forces during weightbearing activities and can be a cost-effective and noninvasive treatment modality.

pmc-11488468.title: Documented penicillin allergy and beta-lactam antibiotic use in Massachusetts long-term care facilities: opportunities for penicillin allergy delabeling
pmc-11488468.creator: Kap Sum Foong, Shira Doron, Leslie Fowle, Melissa Cumming, Jessica Leaf, Barbara Bolstorff, Christina Brandeburg, Ye Chen, Alysse Wurcel
pmc-11488468.description: In a cross-sectional study of 20 Massachusetts long-term care (LTC) facilities, 19% (n = 449) of residents received antibiotics, with approximately one-third having a documented penicillin allergy. This documented allergy decreased the likelihood of prescribing beta-lactam antibiotics for infections. Improved penicillin allergy assessments and delabeling could optimize antibiotic prescribing in LTC settings.

pmc-11508553.title: Traits of Developmental Disorders in Adults With Listening Difficulties Without Diagnosis of Autism Spectrum Disorder And/or Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder
pmc-11508553.creator: Chie Obuchi, Tetsuaki Kawase, Yuka Sasame, Yayoi Yamamoto, Kaori Sasaki, Junya Iwasaki, Hidehiko Okamoto, Kimitaka Kaga
pmc-11508553.description: Background: Some individuals have a normal audiogram but have listening difficulties (LiD). As many studies have investigated the relationship between listening and developmental disorders, the traits of developmental disorders might explain the symptoms of LiD. In this study, we examined the traits of developmental disorders of adults with LiD to help clarify the cause of LiD symptoms.

pmc-11538231.title: Lyme disease in companion animals: an updated state-of-art and current situation in Portugal
pmc-11538231.creator: Rita Picado, Catarina Jota Baptista, André Meneses, Sabrina Legatti, Joana Fonseca, Adriana Belas
pmc-11538231.description: Lyme disease (LD) is a globally distributed zoonotic multisystemic condition caused by gram-negative spirochete bacteria of the Borrelia burgdorferi complex, transmitted through tick bites. Research on LD in domestic animals in Portugal is limited, potentially leading to underestimating its prevalence. This disease affects many species, including humans, making it a critical public health issue.

pmc-11677774.title: A Novel In Vivo Method Using Caenorhabditis elegans to Evaluate α-Glucosidase Inhibition by Natural Products for Type 2 Diabetes Treatment
pmc-11677774.creator: María Pilar de Torre, José Luis Vizmanos, Rita Yolanda Cavero, María Isabel Calvo
pmc-11677774.description: Background: Non-insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus, or type 2 diabetes, is one of the diseases of greatest concern worldwide, and research into natural compounds that are capable of regulating glycemia and insulin resistance is therefore gaining importance. In the preclinical stages, Caenorhabditis elegans is considered a promising in vivo model for research into this disease.

pmc-11716941.title: Early CER Strategies to Recruit Black 80+ year olds in the SuperAging Research Initiative
pmc-11716941.creator: Phyllis Timpo, Amanda Cook Maher, Chandler Zolliecoffer, Annalise Rahman‐Filipiak, Gabrielle A Lincoln, Sophia Moore, Avemaria Awosika, Rebecca Devine, Hannah Peirce, Janessa Engelmeyer, Darby J. Morhardt, Ozioma C Okonkwo, Monica Bruce, Sarah R Lose, Felicia Goldstein, Antoine R Trammell, Mary Lock
pmc-11716941.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundCommunity engaged research (CER) has been critical for increasing diversity in Alzheimer’s studies. However, the effectiveness of CER for engaging a diverse population of ‘SuperAgers,’ has been largely unstudied. SuperAgers are individuals age 80+ with superior episodic memory. The multi‐site SuperAging Research Initiative (SRI) seeks to recruit at least 500 SuperAgers and similarly aged controls, including 40% who identify as Black.

pmc-13065759.title: Attention-related modulation in the superior colliculus encodes perceptual sensitivity, but not perceptual choice
pmc-13065759.creator: Supriya Ghosh, John H R Maunsell
pmc-13065759.description: Neurons in the superior colliculus (SC), like those in cortex, are modulated by shifts in attention but contribute differently from visual cortex neurons. It remains debated whether SC attention-related activity represents enhanced perceptual sensitivity, decision criterion shifts, or motor bias linked to saccade planning at neurons’ response fields.

pmc-13146412.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A2492 COMPARATIVE IN VITRO THROMBOLYTIC EFFICACY OF INTRA-ARTERIAL TIROFIBAN, R-TPA AND, THEIR SEQUENTIAL COMBINATION ON MECHANICAL RETRIEVED THROMBI
pmc-13146412.creator: Cristina Marquez, Jia Hui Li, Eder Paredes, Judith Cendrero, Marc Ribó
pmc-13146412.description: Background and aimsIntra-Arterial (IA) administration of lytic agents represents a promising alternative therapeutic strategy when Mechanical thrombectomy (MT) fails to achieve favorable outcomes. We aimed to evaluate the thrombolytic efficacy of IA r-tPA, tirofiban, and their sequential combination on MT-retrieved thrombi.

pmc-13264875.title: Socioeconomic burden of osteoarthritis in Sub-Saharan Africa and the determinants of healthcare inequities: a scoping review protocol
pmc-13264875.creator: Leonel Andela, Breno Augusto Bormann de Souza Filho, F M Pimentel-Santos, Daniele Masterson Tavares Pereira Ferreira, Carlos Augusto Ferreira de Andrade

pmc-13417857.title: Altered NK cell receptor profiles and immune-inflammatory markers in adolescent major depressive disorder: associations with cognitive impairment
pmc-13417857.creator: Jiahui Wang, Lingzhi Hou, Cai Li, Yitong Liu, Yan Xu, Yang He, Lei Yang, Li Wang, Qidong Liu, Jun Cheng, Yanyan Zhang, Yunmiao Ma, Haiwei Xu, Hong Li
pmc-13417857.description: BackgroundImmune dysregulation and cognitive deficits are increasingly recognized in adolescent major depressive disorder (MDD), yet their interrelationship remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate peripheral immune-inflammatory alterations and natural killer (NK) cell phenotypes, and explore their association with cognitive function in adolescent MDD.MethodsFifty-four first-episode, drug-naïve adolescents with MDD and 33 matched healthy controls (HCs) were enrolled.

pmc-13517678.title: Hepatitis B in Isolated Anti-HBc Carriers: Predictors of Detectable HBV DNA and Implications for Risk-Stratified Screening
pmc-13517678.creator: Hasan Zeybek
pmc-13517678.description: Background/Objectives: Isolated anti-HBc (IAHBc)—anti-HBc reactivity without HBsAg or anti-HBs—may indicate occult HBV infection (OBI) and confers reactivation risk under immunosuppression, yet most evidence derives from single specialties. We assessed the frequency, predictors, and diagnostic yield of detectable HBV DNA across multiple clinical specialties in a large real-world cohort to inform risk-based testing.

pmc-13628992.title: Engineering Zr–W Mixed Oxide Heterojunctions from UiO-66-Type MOFs Templates: Bridging DFT and Mechanistic Insights into Organic Abatement
pmc-13628992.creator: Cyrille Ghislain Fotsop, Alexandra Lieb, Franziska Scheffler
pmc-13628992.description: The release of harmful chemicals into the environment is still increasing. This study aims to develop highly efficient and stable hybrid oxide photocatalysts (t/m-ZrO2@WO3-X) through hydrothermally assisted pyrolysis routes, based on (Zr/W)­UiO-66-type MOFs template, suitable for the abatement of organic dyes such as methylene blue (MB) and indigo carmine (IC), using a mathematical approach.

pmc-13643186.title: Predicting disease spread from host movement data: Chronic wasting disease in North America as a case study
pmc-13643186.creator: Paul C. Cross, Blake Lowrey, Matthew Kauffman, Evelyn Merrill
pmc-13643186.description: Rare long‐distance movements can increase the spatial spread of invasive species and shifts in species ranges. For wildlife disease spread, however, seasonal migrations may only matter if they lead to transmission to individuals using different seasonal ranges, and the importance of juvenile dispersal depends on whether those juveniles are infected before they disperse.
